trainer.name: Alexandra
trainer.dialogueBefore: Bird Keeper Alexandra: The wind pours down off the mountain here. My birds love to ride it. Shall we?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Bird Keeper Alexandra: Grounded already! We'll go back to practising our take-offs.

trainer.name: Louis
trainer.dialogueBefore: Hiker Louis: I'm off into Mt. Coronet. A battle first, to warm up my legs!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Hiker Louis: That took the puff right out of me. The mountain can wait a while.

trainer.name: Zach
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ninja Boy Zach: You walked straight past me! Out of the shadows, my Zubat!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ninja Boy Zach: Three Zubat, and not one of them could find a way through you.
